title: Improving Building Energy Efficiency with an Indoor Environmental World Model and Counterfactual Adaptive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33764v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optimizing indoor climate systems plays a critical role in achieving the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals 11 and 13. However, indoor delayed thermodynamic responses and partial observability severely hinder existing reinforcement learning (RL) methods, which are primarily limited by implicit thermal inertia, occupancy dynamic prediction, and cumulative prediction errors during long-horizon rollouts. Thus, we propose a novel occupant-centric indoor climate control framework. It develops indoor environmental world models to predict future physical thermal baselines and dynamic occupancy, explicitly capturing latent thermal inertia. By formulating adaptive regulation as counterfactual advantage learning against future environments via a Branching Dueling Q-Network, and integrating a Held-Action TD-{\lambda} target, it effectively mitigates delayed credit assignment. translated_title: 基于室内环境世界模型与反事实自适应学习的建筑能效提升方法
translated_abstract: 优化室内气候系统对实现联合国可持续发展目标11和13起着至关重要的作用。然而，室内热力学的延迟响应和部分可观测性严重阻碍了现有的强化学习方法，这些方法主要受限于隐式热惯性、人员占用动态预测以及长时程推演过程中累积的预测误差。因此，我们提出了一种新颖的以人员为中心的室内气候控制框架。该框架构建室内环境世界模型来预测未来的物理热基线和动态人员占用情况，从而显式捕捉潜在的热惯性。通过分支决斗Q网络将自适应调节表述为针对未来环境的反事实优势学习，并集成保持动作TD-λ目标，有效缓解了延迟的信用分配问题。此外，所提出的物理对齐平滑正则化方法……
tldr: 该论文提出一种以人员为中心的室内气候控制框架，利用室内环境世界模型显式捕捉热惯性和预测人员占用动态，并结合反事实优势学习与保持动作TD-λ目标来缓解延迟信用分配问题，从而提升建筑能源效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an occupant-centric indoor climate control framework that uses indoor environmental world models to explicitly capture thermal inertia and predict occupancy dynamics, combined with counterfactual advantage learning and a Held-Action TD-λ target to mitigate delayed credit assignment, thereby improving building energy efficiency.
